fields.why:
To ensure mining has sufficient water in MEG 5 for their ongoing activities through the automation of 322-PU-795/796.
50Meg refers to DECANT RETURN POND
5Meg refers to 364-PD-001
fields.design:
A Duty Pump Selector to be added to allow CROs to select either:
- 322-PU-796 as Duty Pump, or
- 322-PU-795 as Duty Pump.
The selected duty pump is to operate automatically when the permissives below are satisfied. The non-duty pump will remain as standby. Existing manual start/stop functionality is to remain unchanged.

Automatic Start Conditions 322-PU-796 (Duty Selected)
322-PU-796 to automatically start when all the following conditions are met:
- 50Meg Level ≥ 65%
- 5Meg Level < 90%
- Pump is in AUTO
- No active pump faults, trips, or process interlocks are present

Automatic Start Conditions 322-PU-795 (Duty Selected)
322-PU-795 to automatically start when all the following conditions are met:
- 50Meg Level ≥ 65%
- 5Meg Level < 90%
- Pump is in AUTO
- 322-XV-6127 OPEN confirmed
- 322-XV-6126 CLOSED confirmed
- No active pump faults, trips, or operational interlocks are present

Automatic Start Inhibit Conditions
Automatic operation should be inhibited if any of the following conditions exist:
- 50Meg Level < 65%
- 5Meg Level ≥ 90%
- Selected pump is not in AUTO
- Pump fault or trip is present
- Process interlock is active
For 322-PU-795:
- 322-XV-6127 is not OPEN
- 322-XV-6126 is not CLOSED

Automatic Stop Conditions
The running duty pump (322-PU-796 or 322-PU-795) should automatically stop if any of the following occur:
- 5Meg Level reaches 95%
- 50Meg Level falls below 60% with a 5 second debounce
- Pump fault or trip occurs
- Any process interlock becomes active
For 322-PU-795:
- 322-XV-6127 loses OPEN status
- 322-XV-6126 loses CLOSED status
fields.impact: Decant-to-5 Meg transfer runs automatically on pond levels with a CRO-selected duty pump.
